title: Gatekeepers and Treasurers

questions.question: Who was the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:1 (ESV): "...Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph."

questions.question: Who was the firstborn of Meshelemiah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:2 (ESV): "And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn..."

questions.question: Why did God bless Obed-edom?
options: Scripture doesn't explicitly state why here, but context implies faithfulness; text just says "for God blessed him"
questions.correctAnswer: Scripture doesn't explicitly state why here, but context implies faithfulness; text just says "for God blessed him"

questions.question: Who were the sons of Obed-edom described as?
options: Able men with strength for the service
questions.correctAnswer: Able men with strength for the service
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:8 (ESV): "...able men with strength for the service..."

questions.question: To whom did the lot for the East Gate fall?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:14 (ESV): "The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah."

questions.question: To whom did the lot for the North Gate come out?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:14 (ESV): "They cast lots also for his son Zechariah... and his lot came out for the North Gate."

questions.question: To whom was the South Gate assigned?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:15 (ESV): "To Obed-edom came out the lot for the South Gate..."

questions.question: Where were the storehouse allotted?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:15 (ESV): "...and to his sons was allotted the storehouse."

questions.question: Who were over the treasuries of the house of God and the dedicated gifts?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:20 (ESV): "And of the Levites, Ahijah had charge of the treasuries of the house of God..."

questions.question: Who was chief officer in charge of the treasuries?
options: Shebuel the son of Gershom, son of Moses
questions.correctAnswer: Shebuel the son of Gershom, son of Moses
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:24 (ESV): "and Shebuel the son of Gershom, son of Moses, was chief officer in charge of the treasuries."

questions.question: What did David, the chiefs of fathers' houses, and the commanders dedicate?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:27 (ESV): "From spoil won in battles they dedicated gifts for the maintenance of the house of the LORD."

questions.question: For what were the Izharites appointed?
options: For duties outside the temple, as officers and judges
questions.correctAnswer: For duties outside the temple, as officers and judges
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:29 (ESV): "Of the Izharites... were appointed for duties outside the temple, as officers and judges..."

questions.question: Who were the able men of the Hebronites found at Jazer?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:31 (ESV): "...Jerijah was the chief... sought out... and men of great ability among them were found at Jazer..."

questions.question: How many Hebronites did David appoint as overseers west of the Jordan?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:30 (ESV): "...Hashabiah and his brothers, 1,700 men of ability, had the oversight of Israel westward of the Jordan..."

questions.question: Who was chosen as chief by Hosah, even though he was not the firstborn?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:10 (ESV): "...Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, his father made him chief)..."

key_verse_text: From spoil won in battles they dedicated gifts for the maintenance of the house of the LORD.
